description: Capability-profile gating (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §4). Every TreeCalc-specific extension parses/binds under treecalc-v1 and is rejected at parse/bind time under strict-excel. Profile-agnostic scalar/function surface is accepted under both where already implemented. Excel-compatible runtime reference behavior is future strict-excel work and must currently fail explicitly rather than drift into TreeCalc semantics.

cases.name: reference-array literal {Foo, Bar}: treecalc-v1 only
cases.note: References inside {...} are admitted only under treecalc-v1 (§6 item 4).

cases.name: tree-path node-as-function invocation: treecalc-v1 only
cases.note: Strict Excel still admits ordinary defined-name LAMBDA calls where Excel would, but not TreeCalc path syntax as a call callee.

cases.name: table structured references are profile-gated in TreeCalc host context
cases.note: The TreeCalc host admits table-node structured refs only through its capability profile; Excel grid hosts own their separate table context.

cases.name: scalar array literal {1, 2, 3}: profile-agnostic
cases.note: Scalar array literals are identical under any profile (profile gates the input surface, not value semantics).

cases.name: function call: profile-agnostic
cases.note: OxFunc function semantics are profile-agnostic; only the reference/literal input surface is gated.

cases.name: INDIRECT string parsed per active profile
cases.note: Future strict-excel should interpret this as an Excel-compatible sheet/name reference if admitted. Until that profile is implemented, OxCalc must reject it with an explicit strict-excel profile-not-supported diagnostic.
